title: Share-report gratitude and bonus

source.title: Thank people who share you in their story
source.original_goal: Thank people who share you in their story
source.demand_evidence: Catalogue presence only; popularity and conversion are unmeasured.

native.messages_text: Coach's Story CTA: "Share this in your Story, tag me, then DM {keyword} for the bonus." Default keyword is SHARED, localized to the coach's language. DM: "{thanks_text} {bonus_text}" Give the bonus once after the actual inbound word. Do not say you saw a mention or verified a share. Unknown questions use the team route; refusal ends this campaign.
native.end_stop: Actual campaign-word DM receives gratitude and the approved bonus once; the coach can retrieve people who reported sharing through campaign history; S. Report these as self-reported shares, never verified mentions.
native.difference: Explicit keyword acknowledgement, not automatic Story-mention detection, reaction or verified sharing.

use_when: People report Story sharing by sending the campaign word in an ordinary DM.
prerequisites: The coach places the sharing invitation; approve gratitude and the exact bonus. Default SHARED is localized.
exclude_when: Do not choose when sharing or mentions must be verified automatically. Never claim that the account saw the share.
Do not configure when required lifecycle operations are unavailable on the actual host.

steps.action: Actual new inbound campaign word in an ordinary Instagram DM. Placement is a coach action, not a trigger.
Send the exact approved first message. Deliver any promised value now.
Stated outcome only. No inferred booking, registration, purchase, verified follow or verified share.
End this campaign on refusal. Do not restart from a keyword in the refusal.
Send nothing for silence or external clicks; enforce current delivery windows.
Same-run repeat does not restart intake, resend a bonus or duplicate capture. Ambiguous late replies need clarification.
Use native team handoff on person request, unresolved facts or approved handoff criteria. Text alone is not handoff proof.

transitions.condition: New matching source event; current account, permission and delivery window verified.
One approved response; no follow-up for silence or clicks.
No inbound reply, or only an external click.
Refusal completed. No permanent cross-source suppression claimed.
Person request, unknown facts or unresolved issue; never silently invent an answer.
